```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r initiate}
rm(list = ls())
# 0a.Declare root directory, folder location and load essential stuff
project.folder = paste0(print(here::here()), '/')
source(paste0(project.folder, 'create_folder_structure.R'))
source(paste0(functions.folder, 'script_initiate.R'))
```

# 1. Load daily timeseries (modeling version)

```{r load}
daily     <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "fishnet_timeseries_daily_modeling.RDS"))
setDT(daily)
setkey(daily, zone_id, date)

screening <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "independence_screening_daily.RDS"))

case_window_start <- as.Date("2022-01-01")
case_window_end   <- as.Date("2022-12-31")
```

# 2. Starting counts

```{r start-counts}
case_year <- daily[date >= case_window_start & date <= case_window_end]

starting_events        <- sum(case_year$outbreak_count, na.rm = TRUE)
starting_case_zonedays <- sum(case_year$outbreak_binary, na.rm = TRUE)
starting_case_zones    <- uniqueN(case_year[outbreak_binary == 1]$zone_id)
```

# 3. Construct strata (zone × year × calendar month × day-of-week)

```{r construct}
case_year[, `:=`(
  cal_year  = lubridate::year(date),
  cal_month = lubridate::month(date),
  dow       = lubridate::wday(date, label = FALSE, week_start = 1)
)]
case_year[, stratum_id := sprintf("%d-%02d-%d-z%d", cal_year, cal_month, dow, zone_id)]

case_days     <- case_year[outbreak_binary == 1, .(zone_id, case_date = date, stratum_id)]
active_strata <- unique(case_days$stratum_id)
cc_pool       <- case_year[stratum_id %in% active_strata]

cc_pool[, case_control := fifelse(outbreak_binary == 1, "case", "control")]
cc_pool[, outbreak_binary := as.integer(outbreak_binary == 1)]

controls_per_stratum   <- cc_pool[case_control == "control", .N, by = stratum_id]
strata_with_controls   <- controls_per_stratum[N >= 1]$stratum_id
strata_dropped_no_ctrl <- length(active_strata) - length(strata_with_controls)
cc_pool                <- cc_pool[stratum_id %in% strata_with_controls]
```

# 4. Build lag 0–28 d exposure history

```{r lags}
lag_vars <- c(
  "temperature", "dewpoint", "relative_humidity", "wind_speed",
  "skin_temperature", "soil_temperature",
  "soil_moisture", "soil_moisture_2",
  "snow_depth", "snow_cover", "snow_density",
  "precipitation", "snowfall", "runoff",
  "evapotranspiration", "leaf_area_index", "shortwave_radiation",
  "longwave_radiation", "surface_pressure",
  "total_bird_abundance", "anseriformes", "predators"
)

# 4a.Convert runoff and precipitation from m to mm. stopifnot() guards against
#    re-running this chunk on an already-converted panel.
stopifnot(
  "runoff already in mm — reload `daily` before re-running" =
    max(daily$runoff,        na.rm = TRUE) < 1,
  "precipitation already in mm — reload `daily` before re-running" =
    max(daily$precipitation, na.rm = TRUE) < 1
)
cc_pool[, runoff        := runoff        * 1000]
cc_pool[, precipitation := precipitation * 1000]
daily[,   runoff        := runoff        * 1000]
daily[,   precipitation := precipitation * 1000]

# 4b.Single-pass lag matrix builder
build_lag_matrix <- function(target_df, source_df, vars, max_lag = 28) {
  src <- copy(source_df)
  setkey(src, zone_id, date)
  lag_cols <- character(0)
  for (v in vars) {
    new_names <- paste0(v, "_Lag", 0:max_lag)
    src[, (new_names) := shift(.SD[[1]], n = 0:max_lag, type = "lag"),
        by = zone_id, .SDcols = v]
    lag_cols <- c(lag_cols, new_names)
  }
  merge(
    target_df[, .(zone_id, date, stratum_id, outbreak_binary, case_control)],
    src[, c("zone_id", "date", ..lag_cols)],
    by = c("zone_id", "date"), all.x = TRUE
  )
}

lag_mat <- build_lag_matrix(cc_pool, daily, lag_vars, max_lag = 28)

non_lag_cols      <- setdiff(names(cc_pool), names(lag_mat))
case_crossover_df <- merge(lag_mat, cc_pool[, c("zone_id", "date", ..non_lag_cols)],
                           by = c("zone_id", "date"))
```

# 5. Transform and z-scale

```{r transform}
skewed_vars <- c("total_bird_abundance", "runoff", "precipitation",
                 "anseriformes", "predators")
for (v in skewed_vars) {
  for (k in 0:28) {
    col <- paste0(v, "_Lag", k)
    if (col %in% names(case_crossover_df)) {
      case_crossover_df[[col]] <- log1p(case_crossover_df[[col]])
    }
  }
}
for (v in lag_vars) {
  for (k in 0:28) {
    col <- paste0(v, "_Lag", k)
    if (col %in% names(case_crossover_df)) {
      case_crossover_df[[col]] <- as.numeric(scale(case_crossover_df[[col]]))
    }
  }
}
```

# 6. CONSORT cascade (final counts)

```{r cascade}
cascade <- list(
  design                 = "Time-stratified case-crossover (zone × year × month × DOW), DLNM lag 0–28 d",
  events_independent     = starting_events,
  case_zonedays_input    = starting_case_zonedays,
  case_zones_input       = starting_case_zones,
  strata_active          = length(active_strata),
  strata_dropped_no_ctrl = strata_dropped_no_ctrl,
  strata_final           = length(strata_with_controls),
  cases_final            = sum(case_crossover_df$outbreak_binary == 1),
  controls_final         = sum(case_crossover_df$outbreak_binary == 0)
)
saveRDS(cascade, paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_cascade.RDS"))
```

# 7. Export primary case-crossover dataframe

```{r export-primary}
saveRDS(case_crossover_df, paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df.RDS"))
fwrite(case_crossover_df,  paste0(processed_data, "case_crossover_df_daily_ind_500m.csv"))
```

# 8. Sensitivity: 1 km and 200 m thresholds

```{r sens-spatial}
count_flagged_ids <- function(id_str, flagged_ids) {
  if (is.na(id_str)) return(0L)
  ids <- as.numeric(trimws(unlist(strsplit(id_str, ","))))
  as.integer(sum(ids %in% flagged_ids))
}

build_sensitivity <- function(threshold_label, flag_ids) {
  flagged_zone_days <- daily[
    outbreak_binary == 1 & date >= case_window_start & date <= case_window_end
  ][, n_flagged := vapply(outbreak_id, count_flagged_ids, integer(1),
                          flagged_ids = flag_ids)
  ][n_flagged > 0, .(zone_id, date, n_flagged)]

  variant <- copy(daily)
  variant <- merge(variant, flagged_zone_days, by = c("zone_id", "date"), all.x = TRUE)
  variant[, n_flagged := fcoalesce(n_flagged, 0L)]
  variant[, outbreak_count  := outbreak_count - n_flagged]
  variant[, outbreak_binary := as.integer(outbreak_count > 0)]
  variant[, n_flagged := NULL]

  v_window <- variant[date >= case_window_start & date <= case_window_end]
  v_window[, cal_year  := lubridate::year(date)]
  v_window[, cal_month := lubridate::month(date)]
  v_window[, dow       := lubridate::wday(date, week_start = 1)]
  v_window[, stratum_id := sprintf("%d-%02d-%d-z%d", cal_year, cal_month, dow, zone_id)]

  active <- unique(v_window[outbreak_binary == 1]$stratum_id)
  v_pool <- v_window[stratum_id %in% active]
  v_pool[, case_control := fifelse(outbreak_binary == 1, "case", "control")]

  ctrl_per    <- v_pool[case_control == "control", .N, by = stratum_id]
  keep_strata <- ctrl_per[N >= 1]$stratum_id
  v_pool      <- v_pool[stratum_id %in% keep_strata]

  lag_v   <- build_lag_matrix(v_pool, variant, lag_vars, max_lag = 28)
  non_lag <- setdiff(names(v_pool), names(lag_v))
  out_df  <- merge(lag_v, v_pool[, c("zone_id", "date", ..non_lag)],
                   by = c("zone_id", "date"))

  for (v in skewed_vars) for (k in 0:28) {
    col <- paste0(v, "_Lag", k)
    if (col %in% names(out_df)) out_df[[col]] <- log1p(out_df[[col]])
  }
  for (v in lag_vars) for (k in 0:28) {
    col <- paste0(v, "_Lag", k)
    if (col %in% names(out_df)) out_df[[col]] <- as.numeric(scale(out_df[[col]]))
  }
  out_df
}

cc_1km  <- build_sensitivity("1 km",  screening$ids_1km)
cc_200m <- build_sensitivity("200 m", screening$ids_200m)

saveRDS(cc_1km,  paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_1km.RDS"))
saveRDS(cc_200m, paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_200m.RDS"))
fwrite(cc_1km,   paste0(processed_data, "case_crossover_df_daily_ind_1km.csv"))
fwrite(cc_200m,  paste0(processed_data, "case_crossover_df_daily_ind_200m.csv"))
```

# 9. Sensitivity: lag-window length (14, 42, 56 d)

```{r sens-lag}
# Lag variants (used only by c_01_lag_sensitivity, which tests how the primary
# model's lag-response changes with different max_lag windows). Only the
# variables in the primary model formula need lag columns built at these wider
# windows — including the full `lag_vars` (now 21 variables) blew memory past
# the 24 Gb cap on macOS R when max_lag = 56 (21 vars × 57 lags × 1.37 M rows).
primary_lag_vars <- c("runoff", "soil_moisture", "temperature",
                      "precipitation", "wind_speed", "snow_depth",
                      "anseriformes")

build_lag_variant <- function(max_lag, vars = primary_lag_vars) {
  lv      <- build_lag_matrix(cc_pool, daily, vars, max_lag = max_lag)
  non_lag <- setdiff(names(cc_pool), names(lv))
  out     <- merge(lv, cc_pool[, c("zone_id", "date", ..non_lag)], by = c("zone_id", "date"))
  for (v in skewed_vars) for (k in 0:max_lag) {
    col <- paste0(v, "_Lag", k); if (col %in% names(out)) out[[col]] <- log1p(out[[col]])
  }
  for (v in vars) for (k in 0:max_lag) {
    col <- paste0(v, "_Lag", k); if (col %in% names(out)) out[[col]] <- as.numeric(scale(out[[col]]))
  }
  out
}

saveRDS(build_lag_variant(14), paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_14lag.RDS"))
gc()                                                        # release the 14-lag intermediate
saveRDS(build_lag_variant(42), paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_42lag.RDS"))
gc()
saveRDS(build_lag_variant(56), paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_56lag.RDS"))
gc()
```

# 10. Unidirectional referent panels for the Bayesian DLNM (c_11)

```{r uni-setup}
# §3-7 build the time-stratified (bidirectional) design: controls are same-weekday days
# from the case's calendar month, before and after. c_11 uses a UNIDIRECTIONAL primary
# instead, controls sitting 7/14/21/28 d before the case, because once a farm has had an
# outbreak we can't call the days after it virus-free.
#
# Primary case definition is CSLT-excluded with NO spatial restriction (n = 88). Note
# fishnet_timeseries_daily_modeling.RDS also strips the 500 m non-independent events, so
# we go back to the un-stripped panel here and keep the spatial thresholds as sensitivities.
daily_uni <- setDT(readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "fishnet_timeseries_daily.RDS")))

# m -> mm, same guard as §4a
stopifnot(
  "runoff already in mm — reload before re-running"        = max(daily_uni$runoff, na.rm = TRUE) < 1,
  "precipitation already in mm — reload before re-running" = max(daily_uni$precipitation, na.rm = TRUE) < 1
)
daily_uni[, `:=`(runoff = runoff * 1000, precipitation = precipitation * 1000)]

OFFSETS_UNI <- c(0, 7, 14, 21, 28)   # case day plus the four weekly referents behind it
```

```{r uni-builder}
# one builder covers every variant. offsets are in whatever unit tcol steps in, so the
# same code does daily (7-day steps) and weekly (7-day steps on week_start).
build_uni <- function(panel, max_lag = 28, offsets = OFFSETS_UNI, tcol = "date",
                      vars = lag_vars) {
  p <- copy(panel)
  p[, tkey := as.Date(get(tcol))]
  p[, is_outbreak_raw := as.integer(outbreak_binary == 1)]
  p[, (tcol) := NULL]   # drop it or we end up with two date columns after the rename

  cases <- p[outbreak_binary == 1 & tkey >= case_window_start & tkey <= case_window_end,
             .(zone_id, ct = tkey)]
  if (!nrow(cases)) stop("no cases in the window")
  cases[, stratum_id := paste0("z", zone_id, "_", format(ct, "%Y%m%d"))]
  cases[, cid := .I]

  # lag history built on the case zones' full series, so every referent carries its own past
  src <- p[zone_id %in% unique(cases$zone_id)]
  setorder(src, zone_id, tkey)
  for (v in vars) {
    nm <- paste0(v, "_Lag", 0:max_lag)
    src[, (nm) := shift(.SD[[1]], n = 0:max_lag, type = "lag"), by = zone_id, .SDcols = v]
  }

  # blow each case out into its matched set, then kick out referents that were themselves
  # outbreaks and any stratum that lost its case or all of its controls
  sets <- cases[, .(tkey = ct - offsets,
                    is_case = c(1L, rep(0L, length(offsets) - 1L))),
                by = .(cid, zone_id, stratum_id)]
  m <- merge(sets, src, by = c("zone_id", "tkey"), all.x = FALSE)
  m <- m[is_case == 1L | is_outbreak_raw == 0L]
  keep <- m[, .(nc = sum(is_case == 1L), nk = sum(is_case == 0L)),
            by = stratum_id][nc >= 1 & nk >= 1, stratum_id]
  m <- m[stratum_id %in% keep]
  m[, `:=`(outbreak_binary = is_case,
           case_control    = fifelse(is_case == 1L, "case", "control"))]
  setnames(m, "tkey", tcol)
  m[]
}

# log1p the skewed ones, then z-scale every lag column so effects read per SD
transform_lags <- function(dt, max_lag, vars = lag_vars) {
  for (v in intersect(skewed_vars, vars)) for (k in 0:max_lag) {
    col <- paste0(v, "_Lag", k); if (col %in% names(dt)) dt[[col]] <- log1p(dt[[col]])
  }
  for (v in vars) for (k in 0:max_lag) {
    col <- paste0(v, "_Lag", k); if (col %in% names(dt)) dt[[col]] <- as.numeric(scale(dt[[col]]))
  }
  dt
}

report_panel <- function(d, lab) cat(sprintf("%-36s %3d cases / %4d controls / %3d strata\n",
  lab, sum(d$outbreak_binary == 1), sum(d$outbreak_binary == 0), uniqueN(d$stratum_id)))
```

```{r uni-primary}
# 10a. primary panel
cc_uni <- transform_lags(build_uni(daily_uni), 28)
saveRDS(cc_uni, paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_uni.RDS"))
report_panel(cc_uni, "primary (CSLT-excl, no spatial)")
```

```{r uni-cslt}
# 10b. CSLT-inclusive, for Table S3. a_02 drops CSLT before the panel is ever built, so
# re-derive the outcome from the raw file with every link kept and paste it back onto the
# same exposure panel. exposures are untouched, only which zone-days count as cases.
hpai_all <- read_csv(paste0(spillover_data, spillover_data_file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(state == "MN",
         dplyr::between(as.Date(date_confirmed), case_window_start, case_window_end))

fishnet_geom <- st_read(paste0(spatial_data, fishnet_gpkg), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  distinct(zone_id, geom)

cslt_cells <- hpai_all %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(fishnet_geom)) %>%
  st_join(fishnet_geom, join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(zone_id)) %>%
  count(zone_id, date = as.Date(date_confirmed), name = "n_all") %>%
  as.data.table()

daily_cslt <- copy(daily_uni)
daily_cslt[, c("outbreak_count", "outbreak_binary") := NULL]
daily_cslt <- merge(daily_cslt, cslt_cells, by = c("zone_id", "date"), all.x = TRUE)
daily_cslt[, outbreak_count  := fcoalesce(as.integer(n_all), 0L)][, n_all := NULL]
daily_cslt[, outbreak_binary := as.integer(outbreak_count > 0)]

cc_cslt <- transform_lags(build_uni(daily_cslt), 28)
saveRDS(cc_cslt, paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_uni_cslt.RDS"))
report_panel(cc_cslt, "CSLT-inclusive")
```

```{r uni-spatial}
# 10c. spatial-independence thresholds. repo-only sensitivity, not in the manuscript SI,
# but cheap to keep around. drops events flagged as non-independent at each distance.
drop_flagged <- function(panel, flag_ids) {
  p <- copy(panel)
  hits <- p[outbreak_binary == 1 & date >= case_window_start & date <= case_window_end
          ][, nf := vapply(outbreak_id, count_flagged_ids, integer(1), flagged_ids = flag_ids)
          ][nf > 0, .(zone_id, date, nf)]
  p <- merge(p, hits, by = c("zone_id", "date"), all.x = TRUE)
  p[, nf := fcoalesce(nf, 0L)]
  p[, outbreak_count := outbreak_count - nf][, nf := NULL]
  p[, outbreak_binary := as.integer(outbreak_count > 0)]
  p
}

for (nm in c("200m", "500m", "1km")) {
  ids <- screening[[paste0("ids_", nm)]]
  d   <- transform_lags(build_uni(drop_flagged(daily_uni, ids)), 28)
  saveRDS(d, paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_uni_", nm, ".RDS"))
  report_panel(d, paste0("spatial restriction ", nm))
}
```

```{r uni-lagwindow}
# 10d. lag-window variants for Table S5. only the model's own exposures get lag columns,
# building all 22 at 42 lags blows past the memory cap.
primary_vars <- c("runoff", "soil_moisture", "temperature", "precipitation",
                  "wind_speed", "snow_cover", "anseriformes", "predators")

for (L in c(14, 42)) {
  d <- transform_lags(build_uni(daily_uni, max_lag = L, vars = primary_vars), L, primary_vars)
  saveRDS(d, paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_uni_", L, "lag.RDS"))
  report_panel(d, paste0("lag window ", L, " d"))
  gc()
}
```

```{r uni-weekly}
# 10e. weekly panel for Table S4. the old weekly panel (fishnet_timeseries.RDS) predates
# snow_cover, so roll the daily panel up to ISO weeks instead and keep the same 8 exposures.
# precip/runoff/snowfall/ET accumulate over the week, everything else averages.
sum_vars  <- intersect(c("precipitation", "runoff", "snowfall", "evapotranspiration"), lag_vars)
mean_vars <- setdiff(lag_vars, sum_vars)

weekly_uni <- daily_uni[, c(
    .(week_start   = min(date),
      outbreak_count = sum(outbreak_count, na.rm = TRUE)),
    lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = .(zone_id, iso_year, iso_week), .SDcols = mean_vars]
weekly_sums <- daily_uni[, lapply(.SD, sum, na.rm = TRUE),
                         by = .(zone_id, iso_year, iso_week), .SDcols = sum_vars]
weekly_uni <- merge(weekly_uni, weekly_sums, by = c("zone_id", "iso_year", "iso_week"))
weekly_uni[, outbreak_binary := as.integer(outbreak_count > 0)]
setorder(weekly_uni, zone_id, week_start)

# referents are the 4 weeks before the case week, so offsets in days are still 0/7/14/21/28
cc_weekly <- transform_lags(
  build_uni(weekly_uni, max_lag = 4, offsets = OFFSETS_UNI, tcol = "week_start"),
  4)
saveRDS(cc_weekly, paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_uni_weekly.RDS"))
report_panel(cc_weekly, "weekly (lag 0-4 wk)")
```
